messages:
maria_cs: quick sync for Harrowgate day0 onboarding — finalizing VPC/IAM/KMS/runbook. customer flagged renewal risk if audit evidence isn't complete in ~2w. Need owners for: firewall egress rules, KMS policy review, CloudTrail delivery, and runbook walkthrough. @sam_network @lee_security @tiff can you own?

sam_network: on it. first ask — do we have the list of external endpoints they need to reach (Splunk ingest, vendor APIs)? if they can use S3 VPC endpoints we avoid NAT egress. :thinking_face:

maria_cs: they said Splunk Cloud (hec.splunk.example.com) and an internal analytics endpoint at analytics.harrowgate.net. preference is TLS over 443; retention requirement is 90d. also they want object-level audit logs forwarded to Splunk.

lee_security: I can take KMS/IAM. need the current CMK ARN and existing key policy. recommendation: CMK with key rotation on, key policy that denies cross-account unless an allow-list exists, and a separate IAM role for CloudTrail delivery. Also confirm CloudTrail is configured to use SSE-KMS to encrypt the S3 bucket.

sam_network: we can do S3 VPC endpoints + restricted NAT for Splunk. quick firewall checklist:
```
- allow outbound 443 to hec.splunk.example.com (via NAT or proxy)
- allow outbound 443 to analytics.harrowgate.net
- restrict source to LB subnets and platform NAT IPs
```
I'll create a Terraform snippet and drop below.

sam_network: terraform snippet (draft):
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  route_table_ids = var.route_table_ids
}
# NAT gw + egress rule will be in the shared infra repo
```

tiff: I can own the runbook update and the customer walkthrough. scheduling 30m for tomorrow 10:00am PT — does that work for everyone? i'll include a short demo: CloudTrail -> S3 -> Splunk forwarder and show how to validate object-level logs. also i'll tag renewal risk in the account dashboard and capture their feedback during the walkthrough.

lee_security: sample KMS policy snippet we should use (high level):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/CloudTrailDelivery"}, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "*"},
    {"Effect": "Deny", "Principal": "*", "Action": "kms:*", "Condition": {"StringNotEquals": {"aws:PrincipalAccount": "123456789012"}}}
  ]
}
```
Will validate and propose a locked-down version for Harrowgate's account.

maria_cs: action owners: @sam_network = firewall/egress + terraform commit; @lee_security = KMS policy + CloudTrail IAM role; @tiff = runbook + customer walkthrough + account renewal tag. please post ETA.

sam_network: ETA: firewall Terraform PR by EOD today (I'll include NAT pool + egress IPs). note — if they insist on Splunk over internet we need to provide stable egress IPs. current suggested pool (placeholder): 54.23.12.1/32, 44.55.66.0/24. will confirm exact allocation in PR.

lee_security: ETA: policy draft by tomorrow morning. i'll also run a quick verify that CloudTrail -> S3 is using SSE-KMS and that the bucket policy allows our logging role to PutObject. if anything is missing i'll raise an item.

tiff: walkthrough scheduled and calendar invite sent to Harrowgate. i'll add a one-pager with steps to validate audit logs and a short checklist for their security team to sign off. will collect feedback during the call and drop into the runbook.

maria_cs: one more risk note for renewals: if audit evidence is incomplete, finance will flag their account for escalation. let's try to deliver the runbook + evidence collection in 10 business days to reduce risk.

sam_network: noted, pushing to PR now.

deploy-bot: Deployment: terraform-ops/egress-nat PR #482 created by @sam_network — review needed. :rocket:

maria_cs: thanks all — i'll follow up after the walkthrough and update the renewal risk status. please add any blockers here. :thumbsup:
